## 🎨 Design

- **KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.6.0.** The VPN, MCP client, debrid, captcha, hoster login and event target pickers take their tiles from GlimStone's catalogs, each provider with its own mark, and the MCP clients stand in seven groups. A long form after a pick scrolls inside the window, the tile you picked last is marked when you go back, and a window with a form stays open on a click beside it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **qBittorrent starts in the Unraid container.** Its version check right after the download needs a home folder it can write to, which the container's user nobody does not have, so every build was thrown away as one that does not run on this machine. The check gets a folder of its own, and the error shows what qBittorrent printed. Reported by @drezin2112 ([#306](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/306)).
- **A share on exclusive access shows up in the folder picker.** On Unraid such a share is a link from /mnt/user into its pool, which a container that only has /mnt/user cannot follow, so the picker called it a folder that does not exist yet. It shows the share, says where the link leads and which path to add to the container, and does not take a folder there. Tracked down by @Kayn2106 ([#174](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/174)).
- **Deleting a download with its files takes along the empty folders its name made,** such as the artist and album folders of a song. The download folder and everything above it stay.
- **A hoster's icon is fetched once** when two pages ask for it at the same moment.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new and changed text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface.
